title: Remove finite exact stationary catalysts and characterize ordinary quantum capacity
statement: A finite deterministic no-feedback protocol using m ordinary channel calls and returning its complete joint catalyst marginal exactly,with fresh output coherent information g,obeys Q^(1)(N^(tensor mk))>=kg-Delta(tau) for every k>=1,Delta=E_f(tau)-max(0,I_c(K_A>K_B)_tau)<=min(log2 SN(tau),S_joint(tau)). Consequently Q(N)>=g/m,and finite one-call exact stationary mixed catalysts characterize Q.

requires: Finite bipartite catalyst tau_KA_KB,deterministic local operations/fresh local ancillas and m forward N calls. No backward communication or true-environment operation. Fresh registers X,Y are disjoint,previous outputs never reused,and Tr_XY Omega=tau for the FULL JOINT memory,not just individual marginals.

The fresh outputs may correlate with returned memory and across cycles. Entropies/coherent information in bits. E_f is formation entanglement,SN Schmidt number,and S(tau) is joint entropy rather than sum of local entropies.
provides: Exact repeatability plus strong subadditivity gives fresh k-cycle coherent information>=kg. Pure-decomposition resource accounting bounds retained final coherent information by ordinary block Q^(1)+E_f(tau). Retain or discard returned memory to obtain the stated sharper Delta and Q>=g/m,without assuming Q>0 beforehand.

Every finite n-use ordinary code with coherent information gamma has an explicit ONE-call stationary realization:uniform synchronized local history clocks store actual partially transmitted states,emit the completed code at the last phase,emit product states otherwise,and prepare the next input locally. Joint memory returns exactly and fresh coherent information is gamma/n. No extra classical communication is required;finite forward-only transcripts give the same supremum.

For every pure exact catalyst,Delta=0 and g<=Q^(1)(N^(tensor m)),for all Schmidt spectra/entanglement spread. The same holds for pure-state mixtures with an orthogonal label at Bob. A clock of pure entanglement levels is not a finite-block boost.

For a proposed uniform-gap construction on the hard zero/positive family,computable m,g0>0 and s>=Delta would yield a computable finite-block gap by k>2s/g0. Thus computably bounded joint entropy/rank,known small-Alice Schmidt number,computably many source reservoir slots and exactly returned pure purifications cannot hide the missing uniform rate.

The source also reports a stationary-input-memory entropy-rate characterization Q=sup_D(h_B-h_E),with fixed-D block error<=2log2D/n and computable compact fixed-D optimization. No computable sufficient OUTER memory dimension is supplied.
assumptions: The theorem concerns exact finite stationary resource return and ordinary transmission,not approximate-return embezzlement,feedback,environment control or a freely supplied assisted channel.
The generic catalyst theorem is independent of a successful N675 hardness-rate compiler. The reverse history construction preserves the original code-rate denominator gamma/n.
costs: Finite startup resource is asymptotically removed by the reported ordinary-block bound,but no efficient preparation,computable catalyst-size selector or computable positive fresh yield for the hard family is obtained.

The source excludes noisy-maximally-entangled-plus-arbitrary-separable-noise architecture as a hidden-gap repair via an effectively vanishing correction and explicit dimension threshold. Hidden-location reservoirs and flower-state restrictions are encoder-specific;general shield-preserving mixed transitions remain unconstructed.
